checklist.evidence: Dockerfile uses deps, build and runtime stages; runtime copies pruned production dependencies.
docker-compose.yml exposes ${HOST_PORT:-3000}:3000 and bind-mounts .mcp-task plus promptSpecHistory.json.
Express serves public/ and frontend uses window.location.origin outside file:// mode.
docker compose up -d --build with HOST_PORT=3010 started a healthy container; GET /health returned 200.
No real secrets were added; Compose reads optional environment values from caller environment.

warnings: npm ci reported existing dependency vulnerabilities during Docker build; runtime prune reduced the report to 4 moderate vulnerabilities.
